question:
**Direction: Select the option that is similar in meaning to the given word.**

Hapless
solution: The correct answer is **"Unfortunate."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Hapless"** means unlucky or unfortunate. (अभागा; भाग्यहीन; दयनीय, अत्यंत दुःखी; नाख़ुश, उदास) • **Example: ***The **hapless**__ flood victims were stranded on rooftops for ten days.* • The word** "fortunate" **means** **lucky. (भाग्‍यशाली) __ • **Example: ***It was **fortunate**__ that he was at home when you phoned.* • *​*Therefore, the option that is similar in meaning to the given word is** "Unfortunate."** • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Happy** means feeling or expressing joy or pleasure. (आनंद का अनुभव करने या उसे व्‍यक्त करने वाला; प्रसन्‍न, प्रफुल्‍ल) • **Fortunate** means having good luck or being lucky. (भाग्‍यशाली) • **Distasteful** means unpleasant or disagreeable to the taste or to the mind. (अरुचिकर या बुरा लगने वाला) 3f:Tb3b, The correct answer is **"writing."**
